title: Solana’s fee overhaul increases burn and makes resource hogs pay
summary: Solana’s proposed fee overhaul would make resource-heavy transactions more expensive while cutting costs for simpler activity, and it increases the amount of SOL burned.

title: Gemini posts $108M Q2 net loss despite 37% revenue growth
summary: Credit card and staking revenue drove Gemini’s services growth in Q2 as exchange revenue fell 38% and trading volume dropped by two-thirds.

title: Shinhan Asset Management partners with Plume on tokenized fund pilot
summary: Shinhan Asset Management and Plume will test a tokenized fund using a Korean won-denominated ultra-short-term bond fund as its underlying asset.

title: Bitcoin eyes new August lows as Binance longs face ‘cleanout’
summary: Bitcoin futures open interest on Binance fell alongside BTC price as analysis published on CryptoQuant flagged mounting pressure on leveraged longs.

title: RedotPay US IPO delayed amid regulatory, legal hurdles: Report
summary: RedotPay’s US IPO has reportedly been delayed as it seeks regulatory approvals, while the company says it secured a US money transmitter license.

title: JPMorgan cuts Polymarket banking ties over regulatory concerns: Report
summary: JPMorgan Chase reportedly cut banking ties with Polymarket in October 2025 over regulatory concerns but remains open to an underwriting role if the platform goes public.

title: Crypto payments barely register among euro area merchants, ECB finds
summary: Crypto acceptance was just 0.2% online and remained below 1% at physical points of sale, while mobile payments gained ground.

title: SEC cancels key crypto regulatory meeting
summary: The SEC canceled a meeting on proposed crypto offering rules after the Senate left for recess without voting on the CLARITY Act.

title: Neutrl pauses NUSD redemptions over undisclosed reserve issue
summary: BA Labs had previously classified a proposed NUSD integration as higher risk because of its counterparty, operational and liquidity exposure.

title: Figure reports $4.3B in loan marketplace volume as profit nearly triples
summary: Figure expects consumer loan marketplace volume to range from $4.8 billion to $5.2 billion in the third quarter.
